note: Raw files are fetched from pinned URLs. The benchmark archive is verified by the SHA-256 of its extracted content (sorted '<path> <sha256>' lines), because GitHub does not guarantee byte-stable archives; the archive's own SHA-256 is recorded for reference. Derived files are byte-stable functions of the sources (scripts/prepare_polyglot.py). Nothing listed here is redistributed by this repository.
